title: The incident: detect, decide, communicate, and write it up afterwards

videos.script: Everything in this course so far is machinery. An incident is what happens to the people around it. {{people}} It has four parts, in order: detect, decide, communicate, and write it up. {{four}} You kill the leader while the shop takes orders. Twenty-six orders fail, and the cluster heals itself in thirty seconds. {{incident}} What is left for people is what the cluster does not know: what was lost, what to do with the dead node, who needs to hear. {{decide}} You write the messages customers read, and keep the appointment for the next one. {{tell}} Then you build the timeline from the logs, not from memory, and write it up without blame. {{writeup}}
